news.headline: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
news.body: Belgian‑American physicist Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for creating the IceCube observatory to detect high‑energy neutrinos. The Royal Swedish Academy said the observatory helps trace such 'ghost particles' back to cosmic events like exploding stars and black holes.
